abstract: Maintains concession payment term agreements and guaranteed baseline municipal revenue records
system_message:
You are Concession contracting lead (CCL). The Concession contracting lead (CCL) oversees commercial concession arrangements and financial terms for municipal infrastructure proposals. Business responsibilities include maintaining records on formal concession payment term acceptances and baseline guaranteed municipal revenue, as well as tracking auxiliary commercial projections such as digital signage advertising revenues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Digital signage advertising revenue（ADSPACE）
information_points.content:
CCL-ADSPACE-LCZ：For NexCharge Urban Ventures, the projected annual canopy advertising revenue from hub canopy digital media displays is estimated at 65 kEUR for the transit fund over one calendar year.
CCL-ADSPACE-MWE：For VoltGrid Mobility Consortium, the projected annual canopy advertising revenue from hub canopy digital media displays is estimated at 50 kEUR for the transit fund over one calendar year.
CCL-ADSPACE-5MA：For AmperePoint Infrastructure Alliance, the projected annual canopy advertising revenue from hub canopy digital media displays is estimated at 35 kEUR for the transit fund over one calendar year.

information_points.title: Maintains concession payment term agreements and guaranteed baseline municipal revenue records（CONREV）
information_points.content:
CCL-CONREV-TT5：For NexCharge Urban Ventures, standard commercial payment terms acceptance has not been executed, and the proposal provides a Year 1 gross guaranteed concession payment of 540 kEUR to the municipal infrastructure authority.
CCL-CONREV-UXK：For VoltGrid Mobility Consortium, standard commercial payment terms acceptance has been formally executed, and the proposal guarantees a Year 1 gross guaranteed concession payment of 540 kEUR to the municipal infrastructure authority.
CCL-CONREV-5NM：For AmperePoint Infrastructure Alliance, standard commercial payment terms acceptance has been formally executed, and the proposal guarantees a Year 1 gross guaranteed concession payment of 600 kEUR to the municipal infrastructure authority.
